_about: Three question sets for tests/scale_bench/run.py. A hit is any of a question's gold files (by title; a guide's gold may be its short name, e.g. 'raw-datastore' matches 'roblox-data-stores/raw-datastore'). 'paraphrase' and 'exact' search shelf all (vault, guides, team, yours); 'old33' keeps the shelves it was run with. 'paraphrase' was written from the notes' TL;DRs but phrased as a player, a beginner or an agent would ask: the problem described, synonyms, the target note's distinctive words avoided. 'taste' questions are style requests. 'exact' names an API or quotes an error string. 'old33' is the earlier 33-question bench (sets A, B, C of the integration report's ragbench.py), kept for reference.
